content.short: N Suite is the proprietary private key management SaaS of blockchain game developer double jump.tokyo Inc.
content.description: N Suite is a subscription-based, enterprise-grade wallet designed for Web3 businesses. It provides teams with a secure way to manage their on-chain assets while delivering the efficiencies required to scale operations. The solution supports growing organizations by enabling secure asset handling and streamlined workflows as projects expand. It is suitable for teams seeking reliable asset management and predictable processes to accompany growth in Web3 programs.
